mapper.select: SELECT m.moment_id AS momentId, m.content AS content, m.image_url AS imageUrl FROM poet_moments m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM game_options g WHERE g.moment_id = m.moment_id) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
SELECT go.option_id AS optionId, go.poet_id AS poetId, pi.name AS poetName FROM game_options go JOIN poet_info pi ON pi.poet_id = go.poet_id WHERE go.moment_id = #{momentId} ORDER BY go.option_id ASC
SELECT poet_id FROM game_options WHERE moment_id = #{momentId} AND is_correct = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT poet_id AS poetId, name, dynasty, birth_year AS birthYear, death_year AS deathYear, description, image_url AS imageUrl FROM poet_info WHERE poet_id = #{poetId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_records (user_id, moment_id, selected_poet_id, is_correct) VALUES (#{userId}, #{momentId}, #{selectedPoetId}, #{isCorrect})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM game_records WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM game_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_correct = 1

SELECT gr.record_id AS recordId, gr.moment_id AS momentId, pm.content AS content, gr.selected_poet_id AS selectedPoetId, sp.name AS selectedPoetName, cp.poet_id AS correctPoetId, cp.name AS correctPoetName, gr.is_correct AS correct, gr.created_at AS createdAt FROM game_records gr JOIN poet_moments pm ON pm.moment_id = gr.moment_id JOIN poet_info sp ON sp.poet_id = gr.selected_poet_id JOIN game_options go ON go.moment_id = gr.moment_id AND go.is_correct = 1 JOIN poet_info cp ON cp.poet_id = go.poet_id WHERE gr.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY gr.created_at DESC
SELECT moment_id AS momentId, content, image_url AS imageUrl, likes_count AS likesCount, created_at AS createdAt FROM poet_moments WHERE poet_id = #{poetId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
